activationItems.name: GyminiDevAppDeployRole
activationItems.purpose: Lambda code deploy (12 non-migrate functions) + Chat ECR push + Chat ECS service update. Environment dev only.

activationItems.name: GyminiDevInfraPlanRole
activationItems.purpose: Creates/inspects CloudFormation change sets against the protected API Gateway stack only. Explicitly denied ExecuteChangeSet/CreateStack/UpdateStack/DeleteStack.

activationItems.name: GyminiDevInfraApplyRole

activationItems.purpose: The CloudFormation service role - sole writer of the protected API Gateway's routes/integrations/tags. Assumed by cloudformation.amazonaws.com only, never by GitHub OIDC directly.
